title: Monitoring, Caching, and CI/CD
description: Add observability, caching, and automated deployment to your Azure ASP.NET Core app.
longDescription: A production ASP.NET Core app needs telemetry, fast caching, and automated releases. This module covers Application Insights, Azure Cache for Redis, and GitHub Actions deployment for Azure App Service.
whatYouLearn: Instrument an ASP.NET Core app with Application Insights
Use Azure Cache for Redis from C#
Build a GitHub Actions workflow for Azure deployment
